rules.statement: An order of abatement made under section 396 of the Civil Procedure Code does not prevent a lessee from maintaining an independent action against a defendant, provided that the lessee's right to relief depends on the validity of his lessor’s title and the lessee had already instituted proceedings before the order of abatement.
rules.supporting_quote: "Section 403 primarily affects only a plaintiff or his legal representatives. It is unnecessary to decide for the purposes of this appeal whether a person who, after the date of an order for abatement in an action relating to property, purchases or obtains an interest in that property from the plaintiff, would be prevented (as a privy) by some other principle of law"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 403 of the Civil Procedure Code
